note: Clips per role for Meshy (scripts/assets/people3d/meshy.mjs). A number is a Meshy library action_id (names: output/meshy/library.json, free to list); 'm:<name>' is a text-to-motion clip from 'motions' (made once, 10 credits, kept by Meshy 3 days, then remade). Each role has p1 (made first) and p2 (only when every p1 is done and credits remain), most-wanted first. A person's role is its 'clips' field in art/people-cast.json; women and girls also take the 'female' replacements. 'render' is frames per facing and the render mode per clip (4 frames when not listed).

clap.prompt: A person stands still and claps both hands together in front of the chest, steady applause, feet planted.

eat.prompt: A person stands and eats a burger held in the right hand, raising it to the mouth, taking a bite, chewing, lowering it.

chip.prompt: A golfer addresses a ball with knees slightly bent and makes a short chip shot: a small backswing to hip height and a smooth short follow-through, then holds the finish.

putt.prompt: A golfer bends over a putt, eyes down, arms hanging, rocks the shoulders for a short smooth pendulum putting stroke, holds still, then looks up toward the hole.

practice_swing.prompt: A golfer stands beside the ball and makes two slow half practice swings with a club, then steps forward to address.

demo_swing.prompt: A golf coach demonstrates a swing slowly: takes the club back to the top, pauses, points at his own hands with the left hand, then swings through slowly to the finish.

grill.prompt: A man stands at a kettle barbecue grill and flips burgers with a spatula in the right hand, reaching forward to the grill, turning food, stepping back slightly.

dig.prompt: A groundskeeper digs with a shovel: pushes the blade into the ground with the foot, levers it back, lifts the soil and tips it to the side.

sweep.prompt: A janitor sweeps the floor with a long push broom held in both hands, pushing it forward in steady strokes while stepping slowly forward.

thumbs_up.prompt: A person nods and gives an encouraging thumbs up with the right hand, then lowers the hand.

handshake.prompt: A person steps forward, shakes hands firmly with the right hand with someone in front, pats their shoulder with the left hand, steps back.

tip_cap.prompt: A golfer touches the brim of his cap with the right hand to acknowledge applause, nods to the crowd, then lowers the hand.

lift_trophy.prompt: A winner holds a large trophy with both hands, lifts it high above the head, turns slightly left and right to show it, then brings it down to the chest.

receive_trophy.prompt: A person reaches forward with both hands to receive a large object from someone in front, takes it, brings it to the chest and smiles.

present_trophy.prompt: An official holds a large trophy at the chest with both hands, steps forward and hands it over to someone in front, then lets go and claps once.

hug.prompt: Two arms open wide, a person steps forward and hugs someone of the same height warmly, rocking gently, then steps back holding their shoulders.

run_hug.prompt: A person runs a few steps forward excitedly, arms opening, and throws the arms around someone in a big hug, then bounces with joy.

wipe_tears.prompt: A happy emotional person puts the right hand on the chest, then wipes the eyes with the back of the hand, smiling, and claps lightly.

announce_mic.prompt: A person stands holding a microphone near the mouth in the right hand and announces, gesturing outward with the left hand.

write.prompt: A person holds a clipboard in the left hand and writes on it with a pen in the right hand, looks up, then writes again.

photo_phone.prompt: A spectator raises a small camera with both hands to the eyes, holds still to take a photo, then lowers it.

quiet_sign.prompt: A marshal raises a paddle sign high above the head with the right arm straight up and holds it still, standing tall and silent.

wave_back.prompt: A marshal faces a crowd and waves both arms back and down, palms out, gesturing people to step back and make room.

point_way.prompt: A person points firmly along a path with the left arm extended, looks back over the shoulder and points again.

guard_stand.prompt: A security guard stands still with arms folded across the chest, feet apart, turning the head slowly to watch the crowd.

check_ticket.prompt: A gate attendant takes a ticket from someone with the right hand, looks at it, tears it and hands it back.

camera_walk.prompt: A TV cameraman walks slowly forward with a large video camera on the right shoulder, right hand on the camera, eye to the viewfinder.

film.prompt: A TV cameraman stands with a large video camera on the right shoulder, eye at the viewfinder, slowly panning left and right to follow action.

camera_kneel.prompt: A cameraman kneels on one knee with a big video camera on the shoulder, filming low and holding very still.

photo_crouch.prompt: A press photographer crouches low holding a large camera with a long lens to the eye with both hands and takes several photos.

photo_stand.prompt: A press photographer stands holding a large camera with a long lens to the eye with both hands, turning slightly to follow and taking photos.

bag_walk.prompt: A caddie walks forward carrying a heavy golf bag on the right shoulder by its strap, right hand on the strap, steady pace.

hand_club.prompt: A caddie standing beside a golf bag pulls out a club with the right hand and hands it to someone beside him.

rake_bunker.prompt: A person smooths sand with a long rake held in both hands, pulling it back toward the body in short strokes while stepping backwards.

flag_tend.prompt: A caddie stands beside the hole holding a flagstick upright with the right hand, then pulls it out and steps away holding it.

clean_ball.prompt: A caddie wipes a golf ball with a towel held in both hands, turning it, then hands the ball forward.

tube_pick.prompt: A worker walks slowly and presses a long tube ball retriever down onto golf balls on the grass again and again, picking them up.

dump_bucket.prompt: A worker lifts a full bucket with both hands and tips it forward to pour golf balls out, then lowers the empty bucket.

tee_up.prompt: A golfer bends down, places a ball on a tee in the ground, straightens up and takes the address stance.

lean_club.prompt: A golfer stands relaxed, leaning on a golf club planted like a cane with both hands on the grip, shifting weight, watching.

place_score.prompt: A person reaches up high with the right hand to hang a number card on a tall board, steps back and looks at it.

serve_food.prompt: A server reaches forward over a counter and hands a plate of food with both hands, then a small nod.

pour_drink.prompt: A person holds a cup in the left hand and pours a drink from a jug in the right hand, then holds the cup out.

carry_tray.prompt: A waitress walks carefully carrying a tray of drinks held up flat on the right hand at shoulder height.

cut_cup.prompt: A greenkeeper stands on a putting green and pushes a hole cutter tube down into the ground with both hands and a foot, twists, and lifts out a plug.

push_mower.prompt: A greenkeeper walks slowly forward pushing a walk-behind mower with both hands on the handle bar.

empty_bin.prompt: A janitor lifts a bag out of a trash bin with both hands, ties it, and swings it over the shoulder.

hand_out.prompt: A volunteer holds a stack of leaflets in the left hand and hands one forward with the right hand, smiling, then the next.

sign_autograph.prompt: A golfer takes a cap from someone, signs it with a pen, and hands it back with a smile.

club_throw.prompt: An angry golfer after a bad shot spins and hurls a golf club side-arm far away with the right arm, then stands with both hands on the hips, shaking the head.

angry_walk.prompt: An angry man walks fast and stiffly forward, head down, shoulders hunched, fists clenched at the sides, stomping each step.

fist_shout.prompt: A furious man raises the right fist high in the air and shouts angrily at the sky, leaning forward, then drops the arm in disgust.
